div.p: Orchestrates volumes Manages replicas Handles snapshots

✓ 3-way replication (data on 3 nodes) ✓ Automatic failover on node failure ✓ Point-in-time snapshots ✓ Volume backup & restore ✓ Web UI at 192.168.11.201 ✓ ReadWriteOnce & ReadWriteMany ✓ Dynamic provisioning
• Node failure → 2 replicas remain • 2 nodes fail → 1 replica (degraded) • Volume rebuild → auto-replication • Data loss → restore from snapshot
